issue.title: [yang-models] missing ACCEPT in sonic-types.yang which used in ACL

resolution.title: [yang] support acl ACCEPT action
resolution.description:
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9638
#### Why I did it
ACL have ACCEPT action indeed, but yang doesn't support it.
#### How I did it
Add 'ACCEPT' enum to sonic-types.yang.j2
#### How to verify it
Run the YANG model unit tests
